strings: Writes his saved value, stock = 0; records order 104; commits.
Two mugs sold from one. Stock is still 0, so stock ≥ 0 has not been broken.
Runs the conditional UPDATE. It changes one row.
Her transaction holds the P7 row lock. Its new stock is 0, still uncommitted.
He waits for Mina’s transaction to finish.
Records order 103 and its lines; commits.
Her stock changes and order become visible together; the P7 row lock is released.
His UPDATE checks stock > 0 again, against the updated row.
Stock is 0. No row matches; the UPDATE returns no row.
The application rolls back his transaction.
Order 104 does not commit. Only Mina bought the last mug.
